_comment: Constants and structs shared by C++ and shaders, one source for both (sub-project 2b
shaders/shared/layout.glsl and ohao/gpu/shared_layout.hpp from this file; never edit
those by hand. Struct layouts are std430 (push constants and storage buffers): the
header carries alignas and a static_assert per field offset, so a C++ struct cannot
drift from the shader's. Types: uint, int, float, uint2/int2/float2, uint4/int4/float4,
float4x4. A 3-vector has no portable layout in a struct; use a 4-vector.

constants.name: kCalibrateGroupSize
constants.doc: render_bench's GPU calibration kernel: threads per workgroup

constants.name: kCullGroupSize
constants.doc: GPU culling (cull/instances.slang): draws a workgroup classifies and scans, one a thread

constants.name: kCullLists
constants.doc: GPU culling: the draw lists (5 uints a command, drawCount commands a list): four for each G-buffer phase (instance one-sided, instance double-sided, meshlet one-sided, meshlet double-sided) and one for each of four CSM cascades

constants.name: kCullListEarly
constants.doc: the early G-buffer phase's first list (four)

constants.name: kCullListLate
constants.doc: the late G-buffer phase's first list (four)

constants.name: kCullListCascade0
constants.doc: CSM cascade c's list is kCullListCascade0 + c

constants.name: kCullMeshletLists
constants.doc: the mesh-shader fallback's per-meshlet lists (VkDrawIndirectCommand each, meshletEntryCount a list): early one-sided, early double-sided, late one-sided, late double-sided; their counts follow the draw lists' (counts[kCullLists + i])

constants.name: kCullCounts
constants.doc: GPU culling's count words: kCullLists then kCullMeshletLists

constants.name: kCullPhaseEarly
constants.doc: GPU culling phase: the early pass, the draws visible last frame and in the frustum

constants.name: kCullPhaseLate
constants.doc: GPU culling phase: the late pass, the draws visible now (frustum and Hi-Z) not drawn early; it records visibility for the next frame

constants.name: kCullPhaseShadow
constants.doc: GPU culling phase: a CSM cascade, the draws in its frustum

constants.name: kCullFrustum
constants.doc: CullPush.config.z bit: test the frustum

constants.name: kCullOcclusion
constants.doc: CullPush.config.z bit: test the Hi-Z pyramid (late phase)

constants.name: kCullCone
constants.doc: CullPush.config.z / MeshletPush.config.y bit: test one-sided draws' meshlets against their normal cones

constants.name: kDrawOneSided
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: the material is one-sided (back faces culled)

constants.name: kDrawEmitter
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: a light's emitter mesh, in no CSM cascade (it never shadows)

constants.name: kDrawViewModel
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: a first-person gun's mesh (ViewModel), drawn shrunk toward the eye: in no CSM cascade (it never shadows the world)

constants.name: kDrawSkinned
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: a skinned instance's own deformed mesh (skin/skin.slang): its vertices' boneWeights.xyz hold last frame's position (motion vectors), not weights

constants.name: kDrawMask
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: an alpha-tested material (glTF MASK): in no G-buffer culling list, drawn after the late phase by the G-buffer's discard pipeline (core/gbuffer_mask.frag); a CSM cascade draws it as opaque

constants.name: kDrawTransparent
constants.doc: DrawRecord.info.y bit: a blended material (glTF BLEND): in no G-buffer, Hi-Z or CSM list; the forward pass (transparent) draws it, sorted back to front

constants.name: kAlphaOpaque
constants.doc: a material's alpha mode (its row 3, x): opaque

constants.name: kAlphaMask
constants.doc: a material's alpha mode: alpha-tested against row 3, y (the cutoff); base colour alpha times the albedo texture's alpha times row 3, z (opacity)

constants.name: kAlphaBlend
constants.doc: a material's alpha mode: blended by base colour alpha times the albedo texture's alpha times row 3, z (opacity)

constants.name: kMaterialRows
constants.doc: float4 rows a material holds in the material table: 0 (baseColor, albedoTex), 1 (specular_roughness, base_metalness, normalTex, emissiveTex), 2 (roughMetalTex, emission_luminance, subsurface, occlusionTex), 3 (alpha mode, cutoff, opacity, base colour alpha), 4 (specular_color, specular_weight), 5 (specular_ior, base_diffuse_roughness, base_weight, specularTex), 6 (emission_color, specularColorTex)

constants.name: kVfxGroupSize
constants.doc: vfx.expand (vfx/expand.slang): particles a workgroup evaluates, one a thread

constants.name: kVfxSortMax
constants.doc: vfx.sort (vfx/sort.slang): an alpha-blended batch of at most this many particles is sorted back to front in one workgroup (bitonic); a larger one draws in index order

constants.name: kVfxCurveKeys
constants.doc: an emitter's colour and alpha curves hold at most this many keys on the GPU (VfxEmitterGpu)

constants.name: kVfxBlendAdditive
constants.doc: VfxEmitterGpu.look.x: additive (order-independent, never sorted)

constants.name: kVfxBlendAlpha
constants.doc: VfxEmitterGpu.look.x: alpha blended (straight alpha)

constants.name: kVfxBlendPremultiplied
constants.doc: VfxEmitterGpu.look.x: premultiplied alpha

constants.name: kVfxNoTexture
constants.doc: VfxEmitterGpu.look.z: no texture (a soft round dot)

constants.name: kSmokeSpheresMax
constants.doc: smoke proxy spheres the upload holds (caps.proxies is at most this; the set's default is 32)

constants.name: kSmokeSphereStride
constants.doc: bytes a SmokeSphereGpu takes in the proxy buffer (rt/smoke_proxy.slang reads it as bytes)

constants.name: kSmokeSpheresOffset
constants.doc: byte offset of the first SmokeSphereGpu in the proxy buffer; the SmokeProxyHeaderGpu is before it

constants.name: kSkinGroupSize
constants.doc: skin (skin/skin.slang): vertices a workgroup; skin.bounds: meshlets a workgroup

constants.name: kInstanceViewModel
constants.doc: InstanceGpu.flags bit: a first-person gun's mesh (ViewModel): lit like any surface, but in no shadow, GI or bounce ray's mask (kTlasMaskViewModel)

constants.name: kInstanceEmitter
constants.doc: InstanceGpu.flags bit: a light's emitter mesh (RenderScene makes one for each point, spot and area light): pure emission, InstanceGpu.emitterLight.rgb its radiance, lit by nothing

constants.name: kTlasMaskScene
constants.doc: TLAS instance mask of every scene instance

constants.name: kTlasMaskEmitter
constants.doc: TLAS instance mask of a light's emitter mesh: the path tracer's camera and bounce rays (a bounce that meets it is weighed against its light's sampling, by InstanceGpu.emitterLight.w) and the realtime tracer's camera and near-mirror rays see it; no shadow or GI ray, so it shadows nothing and lights nothing twice

constants.name: kTlasMaskViewModel
constants.doc: TLAS instance mask of a first-person gun's mesh (ViewModel): only camera rays and a near-mirror's first specular ray see it, so its shrunk pose shadows nothing and no bounce meets it

constants.name: kTlasMaskTransparent
constants.doc: TLAS instance mask of an instance whose every material is blended (glTF BLEND): only the path tracer's camera rays see it, so in the hybrid frame it casts no shadow and bounces no GI

constants.name: kRayMaskScene
constants.doc: ray mask of shadow and GI rays and the realtime tracer's bounces: scene instances only (the reference path tracer's bounces add kTlasMaskEmitter)

constants.name: kRayMaskCamera
constants.doc: ray mask of the path tracer's camera rays, and of a near-mirror first hit's specular ray (ptMirrorRoughness): scene instances, light emitters, first-person guns and blended instances

constants.name: kMeshletMaxVertices
constants.doc: a meshlet's vertices at most (the mesh shader's output vertices)

constants.name: kMeshletMaxTriangles
constants.doc: a meshlet's triangles at most (the mesh shader's output primitives)

constants.name: kMeshletTaskGroup
constants.doc: meshlets a task-shader workgroup tests (one thread each)

constants.name: kMeshletMinTriangles
constants.doc: geometry auto: a draw with fewer triangles stays on the instance path (measured: a few-meshlet draw costs more to launch than its culling saves)

constants.name: kMeshletVertexShift
constants.doc: the fallback's per-meshlet draws: firstVertex = the draw's index << this (a meshlet's 372 vertices at most fit below), firstInstance = the meshlet

constants.name: kGeometryInstances
constants.doc: CullPush.extra.z: every draw on the instance path

constants.name: kGeometryAuto
constants.doc: CullPush.extra.z: draws of kMeshletMinTriangles or more on the meshlet path

constants.name: kGeometryMeshlets
constants.doc: CullPush.extra.z: every draw with meshlets on the meshlet path

constants.name: kCalibrateElements
constants.doc: the calibration buffer's uint count (1 MiB)

constants.name: kLightCapacity
constants.doc: the raster light table's capacity (LightGpu records): lights past it are dropped, with a warning

constants.name: kClusterTilesX
constants.doc: clustered lighting: screen tiles across (froxel columns), at any resolution

constants.name: kClusterTilesY
constants.doc: clustered lighting: screen tiles down

constants.name: kClusterSlices
constants.doc: clustered lighting: exponential depth slices from kClusterNear to the camera's far plane

constants.name: kClusterCount
constants.doc: kClusterTilesX * kClusterTilesY * kClusterSlices; froxel f = (slice * kClusterTilesY + y) * kClusterTilesX + x

constants.name: kClusterMaxLights
constants.doc: a froxel's light list holds at most this many (the first, in light order); the rest are counted as overflow

constants.name: kClusterGroupSize
constants.doc: lights.cluster (compute/light_cluster.slang): threads a froxel's workgroup, lights tested a round

constants.name: kClusterNear
constants.doc: clustered lighting: the first slice's near distance in metres (nearer pixels use slice 0)

constants.name: kShadowMaxLights
constants.doc: RT shadows: the shadow-casting lights a frame traces at most (the lighting pass's light table), one visibility channel each

constants.name: kShadowLightsPerPixel
constants.doc: RT shadows, realtime: the lights a pixel traces at most, the most important first

constants.name: kShadowReferenceRays
constants.doc: RT shadows, reference quality: rays a light a pixel a frame

constants.name: kShadowHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT shadows, realtime: the temporal accumulation's longest history (its smallest blend weight is 1/this)

constants.name: kShadowFilterTile
constants.doc: RT shadows' filter: the pixels a workgroup filters, this many on a side

constants.name: kShadowFilterRadius
constants.doc: RT shadows' filter: the spatial kernel's radius (5x5)

constants.name: kGIWeighedLights
constants.doc: RT GI: a bounce weighs every light by what it gives when the frame has this many or fewer

constants.name: kGILightCandidates
constants.doc: RT GI: past kGIWeighedLights, the candidates a bounce draws by power (an alias table) and resamples by what they give

constants.name: kGIRealtimeRays
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: cosine rays a half-resolution pixel a frame

constants.name: kGIReferenceRays
constants.doc: RT GI, reference quality: cosine rays a full-resolution pixel a frame

constants.name: kGIHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: the long temporal accumulation's longest history (its smallest blend weight is 1/this)

constants.name: kGIFastHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: the short accumulation's longest history; its neighbourhood's range clamps the long one

constants.name: kGITile
constants.doc: RT GI's denoiser: the pixels a workgroup of the temporal pass covers, this many on a side

constants.name: kSSSTile
constants.doc: SSS: the side of a classified tile in pixels (a workgroup of the blur covers one)

constants.name: kSSSMaxTiles
constants.doc: SSS: tiles the classification buffer holds (an 8192x8192 frame)

constants.name: kSSSHeaderWords
constants.doc: SSS: the classification buffer's header, uints: the vertical blur's indirect dispatch (x, y, z, pad), then the horizontal blur's; the per-tile mask, the vertical list and the horizontal list follow, kSSSMaxTiles uints each

constants.name: kSSSRadiusTiles
constants.doc: SSS: the tile rows above and below a skin tile the horizontal blur also covers (the vertical kernel reaches 3 x width <= 32 px)

constants.name: kInstanceGpuStride
constants.doc: render::InstanceGpu's size in bytes (the instance table RT GI's hitMaterial reads a hit's mesh and materials from)

constants.name: kEnvPrefilterLevels
constants.doc: the prefiltered environment (ibl/env_prefilter.slang): mip levels, level i GGX-convolved at roughness i / (kEnvPrefilterLevels - 1); level 0 is the environment itself

constants.name: kEnvIrradianceWidth
constants.doc: the cosine-convolved environment (mean incoming radiance, diffuse irradiance over pi), equirectangular, this wide and half as tall

structs.name: CalibratePush
structs.doc: the calibration kernel's push constants

fields.name: iterations
fields.doc: hash rounds per element

structs.name: ShadowLight
structs.doc: one shadow-casting light as RT shadows trace it (a storage buffer of kShadowMaxLights)

fields.name: positionAndType
fields.doc: xyz position (directional: its travel direction; rect: a corner); w type: 0 directional, 1 sphere, 2 rect

fields.name: edge1AndRadius
fields.doc: xyz the rect's first edge (a spot: its unit direction); w the light's bounding radius: a sphere's radius, a rect's half diagonal (directional: angular radius, rad)

fields.name: edge2AndRange
fields.doc: xyz the rect's second edge (a sphere: x the spot's outer-cone cosine, -2 a point light); w the range (0: unlimited)

fields.name: centreAndIntensity
fields.doc: xyz the light's centre (directional: the unit vector toward it), w its intensity: the per-pixel importance

structs.name: ShadowTracePush
structs.doc: RT shadows' trace (rt/shadow_trace.slang) push constants

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x width, y height, z lights, w lights a pixel at most (realtime)

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset, z quality (0 realtime, 1 reference), w rays a light

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the filter's depth guide is the distance from it)

fields.name: history
fields.doc: x reference: the frames already in the running means (0: start them again)

structs.name: ShadowFilterPush
structs.doc: RT shadows' filter (rt/shadow_filter.slang) push constants

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x width, y height, z lights, w history frames (0: none)

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset: the output's dither

structs.name: GILight
structs.doc: one light as RT GI's bounce sees it (a storage buffer of every raster light but flashes), attenuated as the lighting pass attenuates it

fields.name: positionAndType
fields.doc: xyz position (a rect: its centre); w type: 0 directional, 1 point, 2 spot

fields.name: directionAndRange
fields.doc: xyz the unit direction the light travels (directional, spot); w the range

fields.name: radiance
fields.doc: xyz colour times intensity; w this light's share of the lights' power (its probability when candidates are drawn)

fields.name: cone
fields.doc: x a spot's inner-cone cosine, y its outer-cone cosine; z, w the alias table's entry for this slot: the probability of keeping it, and the alias (a uint's bits)

structs.name: GITracePush
structs.doc: RT GI's trace (rt/gi_trace.slang) push constants

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the trace's size (realtime: half the frame's, rounded up, or the frame's at full resolution); z, w the frame's

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset, z rays a pixel, w lights

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: x quality (0 realtime, 1 reference), y 1 when an environment map is bound, z reference: the frames already in the running mean (0: start it again), w realtime: the trace is the frame >> w (1 half resolution, 0 full; render.settings rtGI.resolution)

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the denoiser's depth guide is the distance from it); w the environment's intensity (Environment.intensity: a miss brings back the environment times it)

structs.name: SSAOPush
structs.doc: SSAO (compute/ssao.slang) push constants, both entries

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the unjittered view-projection: a direction's end projected to the screen

fields.name: cameraPosRadius
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the blur's depth guide is the distance from it), w the sampling radius in metres

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x bias (metres along the normal), y intensity, z, w the distance falloff's start and end

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x directions a pixel, y steps a direction; z, w the 4x4 interleaved noise: 4 bits a texel (x + 4y; z texels 0-7, w 8-15), the stratum k of rotation (k + 0.5) / 16 of the angle between two directions

structs.name: SSRPush
structs.doc: SSR (postprocess/ssr.slang) push constants

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the view-projection the ray is marched in

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position, w the march's length in metres

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x thickness: how far behind the depth buffer (NDC depth) a sample still hits

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

structs.name: SSRResolvePush
structs.doc: SSR's resolve (postprocess/ssr_resolve.slang) push constants

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z, w the half-resolution trace's

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position: the upsample compares distances from it

structs.name: SSSPush
structs.doc: SSS (postprocess/sss.slang) push constants, both entries

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z, w its tiles across and down

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x the kernel's step in pixels (its 7 taps reach 3 steps), clamped to 10

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position: the depth weight compares distances from it

structs.name: GIDenoisePush
structs.doc: RT GI's denoiser (rt/gi_denoise.slang) push constants

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x history frames (0: none), y the a-trous step in pixels, z the trace is the frame >> z (1 half resolution, 0 full)

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the upsample's depth guide)

structs.name: MeshletGpu
structs.doc: one meshlet of the meshlet arena (render/scene/meshlet_builder): at most kMeshletMaxVertices vertices and kMeshletMaxTriangles triangles of one submesh

fields.name: range
fields.doc: x its first entry in the meshlet-vertex arena, y its first in the meshlet-triangle arena, z its vertex count, w its triangle count

fields.name: sphere
fields.doc: xyz the bounding sphere's centre (mesh space), w its radius

fields.name: cone
fields.doc: xyz the normal cone's unit axis (mesh space), w its cutoff: back-facing from a camera at c when dot(centre - c, axis) >= cutoff * |centre - c| + radius; 1: never

structs.name: DrawRecord
structs.doc: one draw of RenderScene's draw table (an instance's submesh), read by GPU culling and by the G-buffer and CSM vertex shaders through firstInstance

fields.name: draw
fields.doc: x first index, y index count, z vertex offset (an int's bits), w the instance-table slot

fields.name: info
fields.doc: x the material slot, y flags (kDrawOneSided, kDrawEmitter, kDrawViewModel, kDrawSkinned), z the submesh's first meshlet, w its meshlet count

fields.name: aabbMin
fields.doc: xyz the mesh's local bounding box, minimum; w the draw's first meshlet entry (a uint's bits: the meshlets of the draws before it)

fields.name: aabbMax
fields.doc: xyz the mesh's local bounding box, maximum

structs.name: CullPush
structs.doc: GPU culling (cull/instances.slang) push constants, every entry

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the view-projection the draws are rasterized with (jitter included)

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x the items culled (draws, or meshlet entries), y phase (kCullPhase*), z flags (kCullFrustum, kCullOcclusion, kCullCone), w the draw count

fields.name: hiz
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size in pixels; z the Hi-Z pyramid's levels; w the scan's block count

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: xyz the camera's world position (the cone test)

fields.name: extra
fields.doc: x the first list written (its count word), y the lists written (1, 2 or 4), z the geometry mode (kGeometry*)

structs.name: MeshletPush
structs.doc: the G-buffer's meshlet shaders (cull/meshlets.slang: task, mesh, pull) push constants, at offset 16 (gbuffer.frag's block first)

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x the drawn list's first command (uints into the culling commands), y flags (kCullFrustum, kCullOcclusion, kCullCone), z the Hi-Z pyramid's levels

fields.name: hiz
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size in pixels

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: xyz the camera's world position

structs.name: HiZPush
structs.doc: the Hi-Z build (cull/hiz.slang) push constants

fields.name: size
fields.doc: x, y the level written; z, w the level (or depth buffer) read

structs.name: LightGpu
structs.doc: one raster light of the light table (core/deferred_lighting.slang, compute/light_cluster.slang)

fields.name: position
fields.doc: xyz position (world; a rectangle's centre), w type: 0 directional, 1 point, 2 spot, 3 rectangle (area light)

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: xyz direction (a rectangle's first edge), w range: point and spot light contributes nothing past it (a rectangle has none)

fields.name: color
fields.doc: xyz colour, w intensity (a rectangle's radiance, I / (4 pi r^2))

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x cos inner cone, y cos outer cone, z the sphere radius of a point or spot light with an emitter mesh (its specular is that sphere's reflection; 0 a point); a rectangle's xyz is its second edge; w RT shadow channel (-1 never, 0..kShadowMaxLights-1)

structs.name: ClusterPush
structs.doc: lights.cluster (compute/light_cluster.slang) push constants

fields.name: view
fields.doc: the view matrix the lighting pass picks froxels with

fields.name: proj
fields.doc: the projection the G-buffer was rasterized with (jitter included): x proj[0][0], y proj[1][1], z proj[2][0], w proj[2][1]

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size in pixels; z the slice scale (kClusterSlices / log(far / kClusterNear)); w the slice bias (-log(kClusterNear) * scale): slice = floor(log(distance) * z + w)

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x the light count

structs.name: SkinPush
structs.doc: skin and skin.bounds (skin/skin.slang) push constants, one skinned instance a dispatch

fields.name: mesh
fields.doc: x the base (bind-pose) mesh's first vertex in the arena, y the instance's own mesh's first vertex, z the vertex count

fields.name: palette
fields.doc: x this frame's palette's first matrix in the slot's palette buffer, y last frame's, z the bone count

fields.name: meshlets
fields.doc: skin.bounds: x the instance's first meshlet (its own copies), y its meshlet count

structs.name: PreviewPush
structs.doc: capture.preview (capture/preview.slang) push constants

fields.name: src
fields.doc: the source rectangle of the final image: x, y its origin, z, w its size

fields.name: dst
fields.doc: x, y the preview's size (each at most the source's)

structs.name: VfxEmitterGpu
structs.doc: one emitter of the effect set (vfx::EmitterDesc), the closed form's parameters (vfx/particle_math.hpp)

fields.name: lifeSpeed
fields.doc: x, y life range (s); z, w speed range (m/s)

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: x size at birth, y size at death (m); z the cone's half angle (deg); w gravity (m/s^2 along -Y)

fields.name: motion
fields.doc: x drag (1/s); y offset along the record's -Z (m); z intensity (HDR multiplier); w soft fade distance (m, 0 hard)

fields.name: look
fields.doc: x blend (kVfxBlend*), y 1 lit, z texture (bindless index, kVfxNoTexture), w frame mode (0 life, 1 random, 2 fixed) | fixed frame << 8

fields.name: atlas
fields.doc: x columns, y rows of the flipbook; z colour keys, w alpha keys (1..kVfxCurveKeys)

fields.name: color0
fields.doc: colour key 0: x t (0..1 of life), yzw linear rgb

fields.name: color1
fields.doc: colour key 1

fields.name: color2
fields.doc: colour key 2

fields.name: color3
fields.doc: colour key 3

fields.name: alphaT
fields.doc: the alpha keys' times

fields.name: alphaV
fields.doc: the alpha keys' values

structs.name: VfxBatchGpu
structs.doc: one emitter of one effect record this frame: its particles are a range of the expansion buffer

fields.name: pose
fields.doc: the record's world pose (origin; particles thrown along -Z)

fields.name: info
fields.doc: x the emitter (VfxEmitterGpu index), y the record's seed, z the first particle slot, w the particle count

fields.name: timing
fields.doc: x the record's age (s): (step - spawnStep - 1 + alpha) * dt

structs.name: VfxParticleGpu
structs.doc: one particle as vfx.expand evaluated it this frame

fields.name: posSize
fields.doc: xyz world position, w size (m; 0 dead)

fields.name: color
fields.doc: rgb lit colour times intensity (linear HDR), a alpha

fields.name: info
fields.doc: x flipbook frame, y the batch, z sort key (the view distance's float bits), w 1 alive

fields.name: light
fields.doc: rgb the light it received (tests read it: lit particles only), w unused

structs.name: VfxExpandPush
structs.doc: vfx.expand (vfx/expand.slang) push constants (128 bytes: the guaranteed push constant size)

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the jittered view-projection (screen positions for the froxel and RT GI lookups)

fields.name: viewZ
fields.doc: the view matrix's third row: a point's view depth is -(dot(viewZ.xyz, p) + viewZ.w) (the froxel's slice)

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position; w the environment's intensity with flag 4, else the constant ambient intensity

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z, w the froxel slice scale and bias (ClusterPush.screen.zw)

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x particle slots, y batches, z lights (without clusters), w flags: 1 clustered, 2 RT GI, 4 environment, 8 TLAS (sun shadow ray)

structs.name: VfxSortPush
structs.doc: vfx.sort (vfx/sort.slang) push constants, one workgroup a batch

fields.name: range
fields.doc: x the batch's first particle slot, y its count (<= kVfxSortMax)

structs.name: VfxDrawPush
structs.doc: the transparent pass's particle shaders (vfx/particle.slang) push constants

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the jittered view-projection the G-buffer was drawn with

fields.name: right
fields.doc: xyz the camera's right axis; w the projection's depth A (proj[2][2])

fields.name: up
fields.doc: xyz the camera's up axis; w the projection's depth B (proj[3][2]): view depth = B / (depth + A)

fields.name: range
fields.doc: x the batch's first particle slot, y the emitter, z 1 sorted

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z the camera's near plane

structs.name: DecalGpu
structs.doc: one decal record this frame (vfx::DecalDesc at a record's pose): a unit cube of decal space, [-0.5, 0.5]^3, scaled by its size and depth (decalToWorld carries the scale)

fields.name: decalToWorld
fields.doc: decal space to world: the record's pose scaled (size, size, depth); its -Z is the surface's normal, out of the surface

fields.name: worldToDecal
fields.doc: its inverse

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: xyz the albedo tint (linear); w the fade (the last tenth of the decal's life: 0..1)

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x roughness; y the normal map's strength; z, w unused

fields.name: textures
fields.doc: x the albedo texture (bindless index, kVfxNoTexture: none); y the normal map (kVfxNoTexture: none)

structs.name: DecalPush
structs.doc: decal pass (vfx/decal.slang) push constants (96 bytes)

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the jittered view-projection the G-buffer was drawn with

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: xyz the eye; w unused

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z the eye clearance in m (no decal nearer the eye: the first-person gun's reach); w unused

structs.name: TracerVertexGpu
structs.doc: one vertex of a tracer's quad (six a tracer, built on the host each frame)

fields.name: pos
fields.doc: xyz the world position; w unused

fields.name: uv
fields.doc: x across the tracer, -1 to 1; y along it, 0 at the tail and 1 at the head; z, w unused

fields.name: color
fields.doc: rgb the tracer's colour times its HDR intensity (linear); a unused

structs.name: TracerPush
structs.doc: tracer draws (vfx/tracer.slang) push constants

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the transparent pass's jittered view-projection

structs.name: ForwardPush
structs.doc: the transparent pass's mesh shader (vfx/transparent_mesh.slang) push constants

fields.name: view
fields.doc: the view matrix (the froxel's slice)

fields.name: camera
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position, w the constant ambient intensity

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z, w the froxel slice scale and bias

fields.name: config
fields.doc: x lights (without clusters), y flags: 1 clustered, 2 RT GI, 4 environment (IBL), 8 TLAS (sun shadow ray)

fields.name: env
fields.doc: x the environment's intensity

structs.name: EnvPrefilterPush
structs.doc: ibl/env_prefilter.slang push constants

fields.name: size
fields.doc: x, y the output level's size; z samples a texel; w the source chain's mip count

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x the level's GGX roughness (prefilter); y, z the source chain's base size; w unused

structs.name: SmokeProxyHeaderGpu
structs.doc: the first 16 bytes of the smoke proxy buffer (set 1, binding 7 of rt/shadow_trace and rt/gi_trace): the spheres after it, SmokeSphereGpu each at kSmokeSpheresOffset

fields.name: counts
fields.doc: x the spheres written; y 1 when the RT traces attenuate through them (render.settings vfx.smokeInGi), 0 when they ignore smoke; z, w unused

structs.name: SmokeSphereGpu
structs.doc: one smoke proxy sphere this frame (vfx::SmokeSphere at the record's age): a closed-form density sphere the shadow and GI rays attenuate through

fields.name: centre
fields.doc: xyz the world centre; w the radius (m)

fields.name: density
fields.doc: x the density (1/m: transmittance exp(-density * chord)); y, z, w unused
